title: Fictional staff-entered family information and private exports
paragraphs: I confirm that this is a fictional staff-encoded demonstration profile. This records staff data-scope acknowledgment only, not youth or guardian consent, a paper signature, identity verification or an account link.

The designated chairperson, treasurer and secretary may review all profiling answers and, after approval, download private PDF or spreadsheet reports for selected profiling sections. All five sections may be selected: personal information, household and residency (including private contact, RBI and family answers), education and livelihood, family and participation, and voice and certification. Optional sibling birthdates are included when the household section is selected.

This expanded export scope does not grant verified residency or official registration and does not permit public release or real-person collection. Retention, withdrawal and deletion procedures remain unresolved. Use fictional information only.
